name: gag_cuckoo_01
read: a cuckoo-clock bird pops out of a door in the notch underside; its spring overextends to the floor, it shrugs at you, and gets yanked back up

name: gag_egg_drop_01
read: the notch is a birdhouse: an egg falls and hatches a chick, mum hauls it up; the second egg hatches a crocodile

name: gag_worm_on_string_01
read: a hook baited with a worm lowers from the notch; a bird climbs over the ledge, grabs it, gets hoisted, escapes; the bait comes back bigger

name: gag_trapdoor_01
read: a hatch in the notch underside opens, a ladder unrolls, a small hooded creature with a lantern climbs down, sees you, flees back up; one eye peeks through the crack

name: gag_tether_juno_bip_01
read: an astronaut tethers to her little rover and floats up into the notch; something tugs the rover in and she is pulled up after it

name: gag_boot_shelter_01
read: a boot from above nearly stomps a beetle twice; under the notch the boot cannot reach; the beetle leans on the notch, smug, and a crumb lands on its head

name: gesture_giraffe_stretch_01
read: a giraffe whose head is up in the notch lowers it, chews, does slow neck rolls (stretch), and the head gets left behind when the body leaves

name: gag_newtons_roost_01
read: five bats hang from the notch; one falls, flaps back and bumps the row; only the far bat swings like a Newton's cradle

name: gag_second_summit_01
read: a mountaineer climbs over the ledge, plants a flag, finds the notch right above, climbs its wall and plants a second flag in the ceiling upside down

name: gag_going_up_01
read: the notch is an elevator: commuters queue, the cabin arrives with a sleeping bear; later the bear returns wearing a commuter's hat

name: gesture_gecko_water_01
read: a parched gecko crawls over the ledge, a water drop from the notch revives it (drink water); it leaves the second drop for you

name: gesture_bear_hibernation_01
read: a bear drags a blanket into the notch cave to sleep; slippers fall out and a paw fumbles for them (go to sleep)

name: gag_black_hole_burp_01
read: the notch swallows every object that passes under it until an anvil, then burps everything back out

name: gag_trunk_call_01
read: an elephant trunk enters from the edge, taps the notch, sneezes, whips out; the strip shakes from footsteps of something you never see

name: idle_under_the_hat_01
read: the notch is a hat brim on a giant face: only two eyes either side of the notch, tracking a fly, then a huge fingertip flicks it

name: idle_iona_bo_01
read: a tiny fish waits under the notch; a whale's giant eye slides in from one edge to greet it, and her tail enters from the opposite edge

name: gesture_camel_drips_01
read: a camel with flat humps sips drops from the notch and its humps pop back up (drink water); one last drop falls for you

name: gag_threadbare_ferret_01
read: a ferret climbs over the ledge to hunt a spider dangling from the notch; the spider hides in the notch, comes back behind it, and the startled jump hits the notch

name: gag_fishing_from_above_01
read: a hook with a worm dangles from the notch; a duck steals the bait; the fisher re-baits with a doughnut and the duck goes up into the notch

name: gesture_clock_clocks_out_01
read: an alarm clock about to ring pins its own hammer, unplugs itself, and lies down on a bell as a pillow (you did enough today)
